ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r1.claim: The passage first names earth-level produce whose observation does not require looking up: grain, grapes, and vegetables.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r1.anchor: things which are attached or are born spread out on the earth

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r2.claim: Grain is named first because it is the chief nourishment and the other produce supplements it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p188/r2.anchor: Grain is the most important thing for nourishment; all other things come under it

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p410/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p410/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p410/r3.claim: حب includes wheat, barley, corn, lentils and similar grains.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p410/r3.anchor: حبا: يشمل ما يسمى حبا من حنطة وشعير وذرة وسلت وعدس

BAYDAWI-FULL:80:26-36/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:26-36/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:26-36/r2.claim: The grain includes wheat and barley.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.claim: The surah explains the call to warn those who fear by using resurrection to purify receptive hearts; human creation and the cycle of food prove God’s power, making rejection astonishing.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.anchor: بأن المراد الأعظم تزكية القابل للخشية بالتخويف بالقيامة

JISHUMI:v10p7291/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7291/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7291/r6.claim: Ḥabb means the general class of grains that people store and eat as staples.
JISHUMI:v10p7291/r6.anchor: حبا أراد جنس الحبوب التي تدخر وتقتات

TABATABAI:80:25-36/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r1.claim: The open reading “anā” begins a detailed but necessarily incomplete account of God's provisioning of human food; ordinary explanation cannot encompass the full system and its cosmic relations.
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r1.anchor: وهو بيان تفصيلي لتدبيره تعالى طعام الإنسان نعم هو مرحلة ابتدائية من التفصيل

TABATABAI:80:25-36/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r3.claim: The earth splitting is plants breaking through soil; “then” and the following “so” reflect the sequence from rain to growth and grain.
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r3.anchor: ظاهره شق الأرض بالنبات الخارج منها ولذا عطف على صب الماء بثم وعطف عليه إنبات الحب بالفاء

TABATABAI:80:25-36/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r4.claim: The pronoun “in it” refers to Earth; grain means crops such as wheat and barley that people eat, alongside grapes and other listed produce.
TABATABAI:80:25-36/r4.anchor: للأرض، والمراد بالحب جنس الحب الذي يقتات به الإنسان

ZAJJAJ:v5p285/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p285/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p285/r6.claim: ‘Ḥabb’ covers everything harvested, such as wheat and barley, and other grain used for food.
ZAJJAJ:v5p285/r6.anchor: والحب كل ما حصد، كالحنطة والشعير وكل ما يتغذى به من ذي حب.

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r1.claim: The fāʾ is suitable if splitting means plant growth through the stage when grain forms: the splitting progressively widens, so grain follows it; intervening human plowing would disrupt the passage's account of divine gifts.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r1.anchor: فإن المراد بالنبات ما نبت من الأرض إلى أن يتكامل وينعقد الحب

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r2.claim: The grain means the generic edible, storable crops such as wheat, barley, and maize.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r2.anchor: والمراد بالحب جنس الحبوب التي يتقوت بها وتدخر كالحنطة والشعير

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r3.claim: A defense of the plowing interpretation says the conjunction need not make every limitation of the first action apply to the second; plowing may be illustrative or may mean digging, since it does not suit grapes, olives, and palms.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r3.anchor: وأجيب بأنه ليس من لوازم العطف تقييد المعطوف بجميع ما قيد به المعطوف عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r4.claim: Another interpretation makes the splitting occur through springs, taking the water poured out as rain and the rivers as its flow; al-Alusi objects that thumma puts the split after the water.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r4.anchor: وجوز أن يكون المراد شقها بالعيون على أن المراد بصب الماء أمطار المطر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r5.claim: The spring-water interpretation also fits poorly with crops following both rain and splitting, since 78:14–15 presents rain alone as bringing forth grain.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r5.anchor: لا يلائم قوله تعالى وأنزلنا من المعصرات ماء ثجاجا لنخرج به حبا الآية

ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r7.claim: The paired verbs followed by verbal nouns signal an extraordinary divine provision outside familiar custom, supporting the reading that keeps the focus on God's action.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p46#2/r7.anchor: كما ينبيء منه أرداف الفعلين بالمصدرين فتوسيط فعل المنعم عليه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p338#2/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p338#2/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p338#2/r10.claim: The grains are the cereals that people eat.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p338#2/r10.anchor: فأنبتنا فيها حبا} يعني الحبوب التي يتغذى بها.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p329/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p329/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p329/r10.claim: God brings grain forth by connected growth that enables nourishment and development; examples include wheat, barley, and other seeds eaten by people and animals.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p329/r10.anchor: أي أطلعنا على وجه الاتصال الموجب للتغذي والنمو

DURR-FULL:v8p421/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p421/r1.speaker: عمر
DURR-FULL:v8p421/r1.claim: Anas reports that ʿUmar, unable to identify abb after recognizing the other listed foods, called speculating about it needless strain and urged people to follow what the Book makes clear and leave the unknown to God; al-Hakim authenticated the report.
DURR-FULL:v8p421/r1.anchor: عن أنس أن عمر قرأ على المنبر {فأنبتنا فيها حبا وعنبا وقضبا} إلى قوله: {وأبا} قال: كل هذا قد عرفناه فما الأب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r1.claim: Attributing pouring, splitting, and growing to God is a rational metaphor; for pouring and planting, usage has made the attribution almost literal.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r1.anchor: الإسناد مجاز عقلي في الأفعال الثلاثة . وقد شاع في { صببنا } و { أنبتنا } حتى ساوى الحقيقة العقلية .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r3.claim: The fa in fa-anbatna marks consequence and sequence, with the interval understood according to the process involved.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r3.anchor: والفاء في قوله : { فأنبتنا } للتفريع والتعقيب وهو في كل شيء بحسبه .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r4.claim: Al-ḥabb here means grain that people eat as a staple; Ibn ʿĀshūr links the wording to the parable of a grain bearing seven ears.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p131/r4.anchor: والحب أريد منه المقتات منه للإنسان ، وقد تقدم في قوله تعالى : { كمثل حبة أنبتت سبع سنابل }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r2.claim: The actions are attributed to God because He orders the effective causes, establishes their laws, and inspires people to use them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r2.anchor: وإسناد الصب والشق والإنبات إلى ضمير الجلالة لأن الله مقدر نظام الأسباب المؤثرة في ذلك ، ومحكم نواميسها وملهم الناس استعمالها .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r3.claim: Attributing pouring, splitting, and growing to God is a rational metaphor; for pouring and planting, usage has made the attribution almost literal.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r3.anchor: فالإسناد مجاز عقلي في الأفعال الثلاثة . وقد شاع في { صببنا } و { أنبتنا } حتى ساوى الحقيقة العقلية .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r5.claim: The fa in fa-anbatna marks consequence and sequence, with the interval understood according to the process involved.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r5.anchor: والفاء في قوله : { فأنبتنا } للتفريع والتعقيب وهو في كل شيء بحسبه .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r6.claim: Al-ḥabb here means grain that people eat as a staple; Ibn ʿĀshūr links the wording to the parable of a grain bearing seven ears.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#28/r6.anchor: والحب أريد منه المقتات منه للإنسان ، وقد تقدم في قوله تعالى : { كمثل حبة أنبتت سبع سنابل }

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p33#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p33#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p33#4/r1.claim: The grain includes all kinds of grain by which people nourish themselves.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p33#4/r1.anchor: فأنبتنا فيها حبا يعني به جميع الحبوب التي يتغذى بها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p323/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p323/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p323/r8.claim: Grain here includes all kinds of grains.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p323/r8.anchor: (فأنبتنا فيها حبا * وعنبا وقضبا) فالحب: كل ما يذكر من الحبوب،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir explains that Abu Bakr and Umar only sought the precise nature of ‘abba’; its being a plant from the earth was obvious from the surrounding verses about what God grows.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r4.anchor: وهذا كله محمول على أنهما، رضي الله عنهما، إنما أرادا استكشاف علم كيفية الأب، وإلا فكونه نبتا من الأرض ظاهر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas was asked about a verse that some people could have answered, but refused to interpret it; Ibn Kathir grades its chain authentic.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r5.anchor: عن ابن أبي مليكة: أن ابن عباس سئل عن آية لو سئل عنها بعضكم لقال فيها، فأبى أن يقول فيها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r7.speaker: جندب بن عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r7.claim: When Tulq ibn Habib asks Jundub ibn Abdullah about a Quranic verse, Jundub adjures him, if he is Muslim, to leave or stop sitting with him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p11/r7.anchor: عن الوليد بن مسلم، قال: جاء طلق بن حبيب إلى جندب بن عبد الله، فسأله عن آية من القرآن

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p704/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p704/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p704/r5.claim: Ḥabb includes all harvested grains, such as wheat and barley.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p704/r5.anchor: والحب : كل ما حصد من نحو الحنطة والشعير وغيرهما .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p705/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p705/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p705/r5.claim: Ḥabb includes all harvested grains, such as wheat and barley.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p705/r5.anchor: والحب : كل ما حصد من نحو الحنطة والشعير وغيرهما .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p206/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p206/r11.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p206/r11.claim: Qadb is fodder or herbage, named for being cut after it appears.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p206/r11.anchor: والقضب : القت والعلق سمي بذلك لقضبه بعد ظهوره

MUQATIL:80:24-32/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:80:24-32/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:80:24-32/r5.claim: The grain encompasses all kinds of grain.

MUQATIL:80:24-32/r12.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:80:24-32/r12.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUQATIL:80:24-32/r12.claim: The Prophet said that people were created from seven, provided for from seven, and brought forth upon seven.
MUQATIL:80:24-32/r12.anchor: خلقتم من سبع، ورزقتم من سبع، وخرجتم على سبع

NASAFI-FULL:v4p318#7/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p318#7/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p318#7/r1.claim: The grain includes wheat, barley, and other crops used for food.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p318#7/r1.anchor: ﴿ فأنبتنا فيها حبا ﴾ كالبر والشعير وغيرهما مما يتغذى به

BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r13.claim: Fīhā refers to the earth split by the plants, and the fāʾ marks succession.
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r13.anchor: أي في الأرض المشقوقة بالنبات والفاء للتعقيب

BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r14.claim: Ḥabb refers collectively to harvested grains such as wheat and barley, and can denote either a little or a lot.
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r14.anchor: والحب كل ما حصد من نحو الحنطة والشعير وغيرهما وهو جنس الحبة كالتمر والتمرة

BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r15.claim: Grain comes first because it is the basic foundation of food.
BURSEVI:v10p262#2/r15.anchor: فيشمل القليل والكثير قدمه لأنه الأصل في الغذاء

QURTUBI-FULL:80:25-31/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:25-31/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:25-31/r3.claim: Grain includes wheat, barley, sult, and other crops that are harvested and stored.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:25-31/r3.anchor: { فأنبتنا فيها حبا } أي قمحا وشعيرا وسلتا وسائر ما يحصد ويدخر

QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r11.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r11.claim: A report from the Prophet says people were created from seven stages, provided with seven things, and should prostrate to God on seven parts.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r11.anchor: وروي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r12.claim: The seven creation stages are illustrated by 22:5; the seven provisions are crops through fruit, while ab is for animals rather than human food.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r12.anchor: من نطفة ثم من علقة ثم من مضغة

QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r14.claim: Crop growth after decay illustrates resurrection from the graves and reminds people of God's favor.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:27/r14.anchor: وهذا ضرب مثل ضربه الله تعالى لبعث الموتى من قبورهم كنبات الزرع بعد دثوره

STUDYQURAN:80:27/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:80:27/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:80:27/r1.claim: The provisions of the natural world invite reflection that deepens understanding of God's wisdom; creation is true, all creation glorifies God, and creation connects with revelation. The passage echoes 79:33.
STUDYQURAN:80:27/r1.anchor: These verses reflect the continuous Quranic emphasis on the benefits that God has provided through the natural world

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p229/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p229/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p229/r1.claim: The grain refers to all kinds of grain that people use for nourishment.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p229/r1.anchor: يعني الحبوب كلها مما يتغذى به

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:20-28/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:20-28/r9.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:20-28/r9.claim: God causes grain to grow in the earth.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:20-28/r9.anchor: فأنبتنا فيها حبا }. { وعنبا وقضبا } وهو القت الرطب.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r1.claim: After summarizing divine favors concerning human existence and nature in verses 18–20, the passage recalls external blessings that sustain human life.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r1.anchor: Yukarıda 18-20. âyetlerde insanın var oluşu ve mahiyetine ilişkin ilâhî lütuflar özetlenmişti; burada ise onu çevreleyen ve varlığını sürdürmesi için gerekli ve faydalı olan haricî nimetlerin başlıcaları hatırlatılmaktadır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r2.claim: The reminders aim to inform people of God's great power and strengthen faith, and to move them to grateful worship and obedience in response to His favors.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:24/r2.anchor: Bu hatırlatmanın amacı da hem muhatabı Allah’ın kudretinin büyüklüğü hakkında bilgilendirip iman etmesini veya inancını güçlendirmesini sağlamak hem de onu bu lütuflarından dolayı Allah’a minnet ve şükran hisleriyle ibadet etmeye, buyruklarına göre yaşamaya yöneltmektir.

QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r32.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r32.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r32.claim: God pours the water of gnosis on hearts, from which flowers of unity and lights of spiritual stripping grow.
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r32.anchor: وصببنا ماء التعريف على القلوب فنبتت أزهار التوحيد وأنوار التجريد

FARRA:v3p237/r11.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p237/r11.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p237/r11.claim: حب refers to grains generally, including wheat and barley.

NAHHAS:v5p151/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p151/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p151/r14.claim: He glosses the description across verses 27–30 as “entwined” or closely interwoven.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r14.claim: One view assigns seven listed foods to people and al-abb to animals, while humans also eat qadab, which fattens women.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r14.anchor: السبع منها لابن آدم والأب للأنعام والقضب يأكله ابن آدم ويسمن منه النساء هذا قول

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r15.speaker: بعضهم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r15.claim: Another says qadab means greens because they are cut, and are food for people.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r15.anchor: وقيل القضب البقول لأنها تقضب فهي رزق ابن آدم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r16.speaker: بعضهم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r16.claim: A third view assigns qadab and abb to livestock, six other foods to humans, and counts livestock itself as a seventh major provision.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p138/r16.anchor: وقيل القضب والأب للأنعام والستة الباقية لابن آدم والسابعة هي الأنعام
